sources.title: Introducing Claude 2.1
sources.evidence: The November 21, 2023 announcement releases Claude 2.1 with 200,000-token context, system prompts and beta API tool use.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models, with Claude 2.1 appendix
sources.evidence: Page 1 identifies the Claude 2 Transformer architecture. Page 15 says Claude 2.1 is not a new base model and increases supported context from 100K to 200K. No exact total or active parameter count is stated for Claude 2.1.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
sources.evidence: Indexed primary PDF excerpts compare Claude 2.1 with Claude 3 in factual accuracy and long-context evaluations. Retrieved excerpts contain no exact Claude 2.1 size. Full PDF retrieval exceeded the web reader size limit; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. This is a partial, indexed check rather than a full-card inspection.

sources.title: Expanded legal protections and improvements to our API
sources.evidence: December 19, 2023 article ties Claude API use to commercial terms and demonstrates claude-2.1 in both completion and Messages API requests. It says robust function calling would come to the Messages API later.

sources.title: Anthropic on Amazon Bedrock Commercial Terms of Service, December 2023
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous terms linked by s4 grant conditional service use, restrict reverse engineering and duplication, and reserve intellectual property rights. They establish proprietary commercial service terms, but do not explicitly state Claude 2.1 weight-download availability.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Deprecation history identifies claude-2.1 as retired from the Anthropic API on July 21, 2025.

sources.title: Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock, indexed historical table
sources.evidence: The indexed historical official table explicitly lists Anthropic Claude 2.1, anthropic.claude-v2:1, Text input and Text/Chat output. The live URL now redirects to a migration page; this verifies historical modalities, not current availability.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: The February 24, 2025 release introduces a hybrid reasoning model with configurable extended thinking. It does not establish a Claude 2.1 dedicated reasoning mode.

sources.title: Third-party testing in AI policy
sources.evidence: Anthropic describes itself as primarily developing proprietary systems. This is company-level evidence and is insufficient on its own to verify the exact Claude 2.1 weight-release status.

sources.title: Claude 3 family card with later addenda
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the complete 46.8 MB official alternate CDN copy and extracted its text. Exact Claude 2.1 comparison tables, including multilingual MMLU and QuALITY, report performance scores rather than total/active counts. This completes the partial comparison-card check recorded in s3.

sources.title: Responsible Scaling Policy, Version 1.0
sources.evidence: The policy explicitly classifies Claude 2 as ASL-2 and requires protecting model weights as core intellectual property, limiting access by job function and preventing unsanctioned release. The exact 2.1 appendix says it is not a new base model; together with contemporaneous proprietary terms, this supports restricted weight access for that revision.

family.note: The 2.1 appendix explicitly relates this revision to Claude 2.0.

release_date.note: Dated announcement states the model is available that day.

open_weights.note: Restricted weights supported jointly by the exact 2.1 statement that it is not a new base model, Claude 2 weight-containment policy, and contemporaneous proprietary terms. This is not inferred from API delivery alone.

license.note: Commercial service terms, including restricted duplication and reserved IP, support this classification. This is not a publicly downloadable weight license.

parameters_b.note: No exact count disclosed in the original model card or later Claude 3/3.5 exact-name comparison tables. Parent retrieved and inspected the complete alternate CDN copy after the initial access limitation. No sibling count is transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact count disclosed in the original model card or later Claude 3/3.5 exact-name comparison tables. Parent retrieved and inspected the complete alternate CDN copy after the initial access limitation. No sibling count is transferred.

architecture.note: Base-model architecture is explicit; the 2.1 appendix says this is not a new base model. Dense/MoE and decoder-only details remain unestablished.

context_window.note: Supported 2.1 context, distinct from the initial 2.0 product limit.

modalities.note: Exact historical Claude 2.1 provider row documents Text input and Text/Chat output, corroborated by Anthropic text API examples. Chat is represented as text.

reasoning.note: No exact-model dedicated thinking-mode specification was located. General reasoning ability or later Claude extended thinking does not establish this boolean.

tool_call.note: Launch beta supports developer-defined functions/APIs. The later Messages API announcement calls robust function calling forthcoming; do not imply every API surface had the later standardized tool interface.

description.value: Anthropic Claude 2 revision with a 200K-token context window, system prompts and beta tool use.
description.note: Replaces the generic historical label with documented distinguishing features.

patch.description: Anthropic Claude 2 revision with a 200K-token context window, system prompts and beta tool use.
patch.notes: Total and active parameters remain undisclosed in reviewed primary materials. Transformer is documented, but dense/MoE routing is not established. Tool use was beta; Messages API function calling was still forthcoming in December 2023. Weight access is restricted under Claude 2 containment policy and proprietary terms; the 2.1 appendix identifies the same base model. Anthropic retired claude-2.1 on July 21, 2025; historical capabilities do not establish a currently served endpoint.

sources.label: Claude 3 family card with later addenda

summary: Confirmed release, 200K context, text modalities, proprietary terms and restricted weights. Added Transformer architecture and beta tool use. Counts remain undisclosed after original and complete later comparison-card review; dedicated reasoning mode remains unverified.
